violation_type.title: Documentation of Training Requirements - Length (26 TAC §744.1331(b)(6))
violation_type.typical_finding: One out of eight caregiver training reviewed is missing the training length on the certificate.

finding_variants.text: One out of eight caregiver training reviewed is missing the training length on the certificate.
Training certificates received do not show the length of time the trainings were in clock hours, CEUs or college credits per minimum standards.

Training certificates reviewed for 1 employee's file did not contain documentation of the required topics shown below:  - Handling, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials  - Understanding Building and Physical Premises Safety  - Responding to Food Allergies  - Preventing the Spread of Communicable Diseases
